facts.fact: A criminal court in El Obeid sentenced pharmacist Ahmed Suleiman Ahmed Al-Waqi to six years, two of them under Article 19 and one under Article 24 of the Cybercrime Law, after a phone search found anti-war messages (per his lawyer).
The article describes the Cybercrime Law as applied by a criminal court to convict a defendant on Articles 19 and 24; the date is the Sunday before the 2026-08-18 publication.
